hooks.command: sh -c 's=.codex/hooks/agent-foundry/ruff-format.sh; d=$PWD; while true; do if [ -f "$d/.codex/hooks.json" ]; then if [ -f "$d/$s" ]; then exec bash "$d/$s"; fi; exit 0; fi; if [ "$d" = / ]; then exit 0; fi; d=$(dirname "$d"); done'
